testInfo.description: OID4VP wallet conformance test for SIROS wallet
testInfo.summary: Sends a DCQL query that requests a credential by its type (vct for SD-JWT VC, doctype for mdoc) with no claims array. The wallet must still return a matching credential, but as no selectively disclosable claims were requested it must return only the claims that are mandatory to present: for SD-JWT VC, no disclosures; for mdoc, no data elements.
